snippet.title: Psychological Horror Game – Echoes (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Echoes is a first-person psychological horror experience where the environment tells a story and every decision matters. Face the Echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

If you enjoyed it, visit the Steam page and add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4536740/Echoes

Music: “Twilight (Horror)” by AlexGrohl, Pixabay (licensed for commercial use)

#IndieGame #HorrorGame #EchoesGame #Steam
